sites.name: Ellery Lake Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $28 per night Additional Vehicle Fee: $10 per vehicle per night
sites.hours: Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from a hand pump
sites.about: Campground is located at Ellery Lake east of Tioga pass, the east entrance of Yosemite National Park. Elevation is 9500 feet. Campground has 12 campsites. Some sites can accommodate vehicles up to 28 feet. Many sites do not have room to park a second vehicle.14 day stay limit. Each campsite has a…
sites.directions: From US 395 at Lee Vining, go west on CA 120, just East of Tioga Pass.
sites.restrictions: Dogs must always be on leash and under owner control. Maximum stay 14 days. Active bear area. All food must be secured overnight and when not attended; bear boxes are provided and must be used (typical bear box size 48" x 30" x 36"). Always keep a clean camp and do not feed wildlife.
sites.reservations: No Reservations, Register at Campground. OPERATED BY: VISTA, REC 11811 N Tatum Blvd, Phoenix, AZ 85028.
